units.source_text: 天上下雪珠了，风猛烈起来，夜色十分凄惨。

en.t: Pellets of snow began falling from the sky, the wind grew fierce, and the night became utterly bleak.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“如此人迹稀少、荒凉寂寞的地方，如何住得下去！”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "How could anyone go on living in such a deserted, desolate, and lonely place!"

units.source_text: 说着，流下泪来，竟不忍抛舍而去，便对侍女们说：“把窗子关起来！

en.t: As he spoke, tears fell from his eyes; unable to bring himself to abandon her and leave, he said to the maids, "Close the windows!

units.source_text: 今夜天气可怕，让我也来值夜吧。

en.t: The weather tonight is dreadful, so let me keep watch here too.

units.source_text: 大家都到这里来陪伴姑娘！”

en.t: All of you come here and keep the young lady company!"

units.source_text: 便像熟人一般抱了这小姑娘走进寝台的帐幕里去了。

en.t: Then, as though he were someone close to her, he took the little girl in his arms and carried her into the curtains of the bedchamber.

units.source_text: 众侍女看了都发呆，觉得这真是意想不到的怪事！

en.t: The maids stared in astonishment, thinking it was truly a strange and completely unexpected thing.

units.source_text: 尤其是那个少纳言乳母，她觉得情形不妙，非常担心。

en.t: The nurse called Shonagon, in particular, felt that something was wrong and was deeply worried.

units.source_text: 但又不便声张，只有唉声叹气。

en.t: But she could not make a scene, and could only sigh in distress.

units.source_text: 这小姑娘心里害怕得很，不知如何是好，浑身发抖，那柔嫩的肌肤感到发冷。

en.t: The little girl was terribly frightened, did not know what to do, and trembled all over, her tender skin feeling cold.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看到这状态，觉得也很可爱。

en.t: Seeing her in that state, Prince Genji found even this very endearing.

units.source_text: 他紧紧地抱住这个仅穿一件夹衫的小姑娘，自己心中却有一种异乎寻常的感觉，便轻言细语地对她说：“你到我那里去吧。

en.t: He held the little girl tightly, though she wore only a lined robe, and with an extraordinary feeling in his own heart, he spoke to her softly: "Come to my place.

units.source_text: 我那里有许多美丽的图画，还有许多玩偶。”

en.t: I have many beautiful pictures there, and many dolls too."

units.source_text: 他讲的都是孩子们爱听的话，态度非常温存。

en.t: Everything he said was the sort of thing children liked to hear, and his manner was very gentle.

units.source_text: 因此紫儿的幼小的心渐渐地不感到害怕了；可是总觉得很狼狈。

en.t: Because of this, little Murasaki's young heart gradually stopped feeling afraid, though she still felt deeply embarrassed and unsettled.

units.source_text: 她不能入睡，只是局促不安地躺着。

en.t: She could not fall asleep, and simply lay there cramped and uneasy.
